meta.notes: Local mock data for a premium hormone reader companion app prototype. Copy stays trend-oriented and avoids diagnostic certainty.

test_session.summary_label: Hormone shift is becoming more active today.

reading_items.relative_change_note: Higher than your recent three-session range.
A clearer rise is visible compared with yesterday.
Still near baseline for this cycle window.

coach_tip.title: Plan for one more check tomorrow morning.
coach_tip.why_it_matters: A follow-up reading helps confirm whether today’s rise continues or settles.
coach_tip.recommended_action: Keep tomorrow’s first test in a similar time window for easier comparison.
coach_tip.caution_copy: Use this result as a trend reference only. It is not a medical diagnosis.

timeline_events.short_note: Clearer rise visible in today’s read.

test_session.summary_label: Connect the reader before starting a new check.

coach_tip.title: Reconnect before the next session.
coach_tip.why_it_matters: The app cannot receive a reading until the reader is paired again.
coach_tip.recommended_action: Open pairing and keep the reader close until connection is confirmed.
coach_tip.caution_copy: Status guidance only. No test result has been received.

test_session.summary_label: The reader captured a session, but the full result is still arriving.

reading_items.relative_change_note: Trend interpretation unlocks after sync completes.

coach_tip.title: Keep the reader nearby for a short retry.
coach_tip.why_it_matters: Most delayed sessions finish when the reader stays open and close to the phone.
coach_tip.recommended_action: Wait up to one minute before retrying manual sync.
coach_tip.caution_copy: No interpretation is shown until the delayed result finishes syncing.

test_session.summary_label: This session could not be interpreted with confidence.

reading_items.relative_change_note: The device could not confirm a complete reading.

coach_tip.title: Retry with the full dip-insert flow.
coach_tip.why_it_matters: An incomplete session can come from timing, insertion, or unstable transfer.
coach_tip.recommended_action: Use the step guide again and start a fresh session when ready.
coach_tip.caution_copy: No hormone trend is shown from incomplete sessions.

test_session.summary_label: A new result is available, but cycle context has not been added yet.

reading_items.relative_change_note: The result is available even without cycle context.

coach_tip.title: Add cycle context for clearer comparisons.
coach_tip.why_it_matters: The timeline becomes easier to read once cycle day is known.
coach_tip.recommended_action: Enter the start of the current cycle before the next session.
coach_tip.caution_copy: Without cycle context, the app can only show limited comparisons.
